'''Laevi''' was a [[Nomai]] who grew up on [[Brittle Hollow]] and [[Ember Twin]]. Their sibling was [[Lami]] and their aunt was [[Pye]].<ref>LAMI: I’m still small enough! LAEVI: You won’t be for long. Mom and Dad are tall, so you and I will be tall, too.</ref><ref>LAMI: Why are we changing it? It’s too hard if you can’t see anything! LAEVI: Aunt Pye says real anglerfish are blind, so you have to wear a blindfold! The rule stands!</ref>

==Early life==
Laevi played the [[Anglerfish]] game in the [[Sunless City]] with [[Taget]], [[Ilex]], [[Solanum]], and Lami. They left instructions for kids who were too tall to fit through the Anglerfish Overlook hole to reach the Anglerfish fossil.<ref>LAEVI: We’re meeting in the Fossil Fish Cave to play the game! If you’re too big to climb through the Anglerfish Overlook hole: LAEVI: You’ll have to go the long way, but it isn’t far. Go to the Stepping Stone Cave, and then up and into the Fossil Fish Cave.</ref> After Pye told them that real Anglerfish are blind, Laevi changed a rule and made the child who played the Anglerfish wear a blindfold.<ref>LAEVI: Aunt Pye says real anglerfish are blind, so you have to wear a blindfold! The rule stands!</ref><ref>LAEVI: Whoever was it when we ended last time is the anglerfish. LAEVI: Rule change! The anglerfish now has to wear a blindfold. (And do not peek!)</ref> However, after some protest from Lami, Ilex updated this rule so that younger children did not have to wear the blindfold.<ref>LAMI: Why are we changing it? It’s too hard if you can’t see anything! LAEVI: Aunt Pye says real anglerfish are blind, so you have to wear a blindfold! The rule stands! ILEX: Rule update: It’s okay if younger kids don’t wear the blindfold when they’re it. (The rest of us will still wear it for scientific accuracy and to make the game more even.)</ref>

==Statue Workshop==
During the construction of the [[Nomai Statue|memory statues]] which were necessary for the [[Ash Twin Project]], Laevi moved to the [[Statue Workshop]] on [[Giant's Deep]] along with Lami and Taget. When [[Phlox]] planned a test of the memory statues, he told them that they were not allowed to come and look.<ref>LAMI: They’re going to test the memory statues tonight! Phlox says it could be dangerous, so we can’t come.</ref> Lami suggested sneaking in through the underground entrance, but Laevi argued against it, pointing out that this is a huge risk.<ref>LAMI: But, what if we didn’t use the door and snuck in the other way? Does anyone want to? LAEVI: I really want to see the test, too, Lami, but that’s a huge risk to take. We probably shouldn’t. Maybe Phlox’ll let us see a later test.</ref>

Laevi passed away after [[Ghost Matter]] erupted from the [[Interloper]]'s core which killed all Nomai in the [[solar system]].
== Trivia ==

* Laevi may be named after the ''[[Wikipedia:Crataegus_laevigata|crataegus laevigata]]'', commonly known as the English hawthorn.
